functions.name: bizpage_get
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.bizpage_get(p_workspace uuid, p_listing uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'zoi', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM zoi.assert_ws(p_workspace);
  IF NOT zoi.bizpage_can_edit(p_workspace,p_listing) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_access_to_listing'; END IF;
  RETURN (SELECT jsonb_build_object('id',l.id,'name',l.name,'slug',l.slug,'path',COALESCE(l.canonical_path,'/p/'||l.slug),
    'description',l.description,'phone',l.phone,'email',l.email,'website',l.website,
    'hours',l.hours,'price_range',l.price_range,'photo_url',l.photo_url,'social_links',COALESCE(l.social_links,'{}'::jsonb))
    FROM zoi.listings l WHERE l.id=p_listing);
END;$function$

functions.name: home_content_get
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.home_content_get(p_workspace uuid, p_listing uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN RETURN zoi.home_content_get_before_revision(p_workspace,p_listing)||jsonb_build_object('home_revision_schema',1,'home_revision_staged',EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM zoi.home_designs WHERE workspace_id=p_workspace AND listing_id=p_listing AND staged));END $function$

functions.name: home_revision_baseline
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION zoi.home_revision_baseline(l zoi.listings)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 SELECT md5(jsonb_build_array(zoi.home_content_version(l),to_jsonb(l)->'name',to_jsonb(l)->'entity_type',to_jsonb(l)->'primary_category_id',to_jsonb(l)->'slug',to_jsonb(l)->'canonical_path',to_jsonb(l)->'address',to_jsonb(l)->'city',to_jsonb(l)->'region',to_jsonb(l)->'country',to_jsonb(l)->'place_id',to_jsonb(l)->'latitude',to_jsonb(l)->'longitude',to_jsonb(l)->'publish_status',to_jsonb(l)->'moderation_status',to_jsonb(l)->'marketplace_status')::text);
$function$
